requirement_vague: Ensure registering a user with an existing email gets rejected.

omissions.description: The signup endpoint returns detail 'User with this email already exists' instead of the required 'The user with this email already exists in the system'.
omissions.reasoning: The requirement specifies the response body field 'detail' must equal 'The user with this email already exists in the system'. The code at the /users/signup route raises HTTPException with detail='User with this email already exists', which does not match the required message.
